Assessment of BA.evidence_source: The 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS; Avalos et al., 2005) was used to assess participants' acceptance of and appreciation for their bodies.

Assessment of BMI.evidence_source: Self-reported height and weight were converted to BMI using the following formula: (weight × 703)/height2 (U.S. Department of Health & Human Services, 2002).

Number of studies.evidence_source: Phrases referencing "the present study" and reporting Cronbach's alphas for measures (e.g., "In the present study, Cronbach's alpha was .95.") indicate a single current study.

section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the instruments used in the present study (12-item Self-Compassion Scale-Short Form, BEECOM body comparison subscale, 13-item Body Appreciation Scale, CSW appearance subscale) and demographic items. BMI was computed from self-reported height and weight and multiple Cronbach's alpha reliability coefficients for the measures in the present study are reported. The section does not provide sample size, participant demographics (e.g., % White, mean age), country, survey method, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI.
